title: Adaptive Generate-Rank-Verify: Inference-Time Search with Costly Verification
authors_zh: Shaddin Dughmi、Yusuf Hakan Kalayci（南加州大学）；Mahdi Haghifam（芝加哥丰田理工学院）
paper_type_zh: 带昂贵验证器的自适应测试时搜索研究
best_for_zh: 研究验证器调用预算、代码隐藏测试或可判定推理搜索的读者。
one_line: ADAP adaptively grows a candidate pool and verifies its top-ranked members, with a constant-factor cost guarantee under a monotone score-success assumption.
ADAP 根据廉价排序分数逐步扩大候选池，并只为高分候选支付昂贵验证成本，在单调假设下接近最优开销。
why: It makes verifier calls a measured budget rather than a free post-processing step and exposes the assumption needed for adaptive ranking to work.
inclusion_reason: It formalizes and optimizes the joint allocation of generation, ranking, and costly verification calls at inference time.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Inference-time reasoning systems often generate many candidates, score them cheaply, and then use an exact but expensive check such as hidden-test execution or answer verification. A fixed generate-then-verify plan wastes calls on easy prompts and can also verify too few candidates when a correct answer is rare. The central difficulty is that the score distribution and the probability that a score passes verification are unknown for a new prompt.

This paper asks for a policy that decides both how many responses to generate and how many top-ranked responses to verify before returning a certified positive. The target is a cost-sensitive search rule whose accounting includes reward scoring and verifier calls, rather than treating the verifier as an unlimited free selector after generation.

测试时推理系统常生成许多候选，用廉价方式评分，再使用隐藏测试执行或答案核验等精确但昂贵的检查。固定的“生成后验证”计划会在简单提示上浪费调用；正确答案罕见时，它也可能验证得太少。核心困难在于，新提示上的分数分布以及某分数通过验证的概率都未知。

本文寻求一种策略，在返回经认证的正例前，同时决定生成多少响应、验证多少高分响应。目标是一个成本敏感搜索规则，其账目包含奖励评分和验证器调用，而不是把验证器当作生成之后无限且免费的选择器。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper casts the setting as generative active search. For each prompt, the generator and reward model induce a score distribution and a score-conditioned probability of success. If both were known, the optimal policy would verify exactly when that success probability exceeds a break-even threshold determined by verification cost and the value of continuing to sample.

In practice those quantities are unknown, so ADAP searches over dyadic generation and verification scales. It repeatedly enlarges the candidate pool and verifies top-ranked members. Under the assumption that a higher reward score is no less likely to pass the verifier, the authors prove that its expected cost is within a constant factor of the distribution-aware optimum; they also show why some score-label structure is necessary.

论文把该场景表述为生成式主动搜索。对每个提示，生成器和奖励模型诱导出一个分数分布，以及“给定分数时成功”的概率。若两者都已知，最优策略会在成功概率超过一个收支平衡阈值时验证；阈值由验证成本和继续采样的价值决定。

现实中这些量未知，因此 ADAP 在成倍的生成与验证规模上搜索。它反复扩大候选池，并验证其中分数最高的成员。在“更高奖励分数不降低通过验证概率”的假设下，作者证明其期望成本与知分布最优策略只差常数因子；同时也说明为什么必须存在某种分数—标签结构。

title: Method
方法
html:
ADAP receives a prompt, a candidate generator, a cheap reward score, and a costly binary verifier. It explores shells of increasing generation and verification counts, ranks candidates by the cheap score, and pays for verification only on the current top set. A run terminates only when the verifier returns positive, so the returned answer has an explicit terminal contract rather than merely a high predicted score.

The theory first derives the distribution-aware threshold policy by dynamic programming, then bounds the shellwise online policy under monotonic score-conditioned success. Experiments cover mathematical reasoning and competitive programming, comparing against fixed non-adaptive policies and difficulty-adaptive baselines. The paper separately validates that reward ranking is empirically monotone on 83 coding and 22 mathematics problems.

ADAP 接收提示、候选生成器、廉价奖励分数和昂贵二元验证器。它探索生成数与验证数不断增大的层，按廉价分数排序候选，只为当前最高分集合支付验证。一次运行只有在验证器返回正例时才结束，因此返回答案拥有明确的终止契约，而非仅有一个较高的预测分数。

理论部分先通过动态规划推导知分布阈值策略，再在单调的条件成功率下界定分层在线策略。实验覆盖数学推理和竞赛编程，与固定非自适应策略和难度自适应基线比较。论文还在 83 个代码问题和 22 个数学问题上分别验证奖励排序经验上是否单调。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The central theoretical evidence is a constant-factor expected-cost guarantee relative to a distribution-aware optimum, conditional on monotonicity between reward rank and verification success. This is more informative than an accuracy-only curve because it states which hidden property of the cheap score permits verifier-budget savings and provides lower bounds when that structure is absent.

Empirically, the paper tests the ranking assumption and compares ADAP with fixed and difficulty-adaptive policies on math and coding. The reported top-ranked samples are several times more likely to be correct than uniformly selected samples in the 83 coding and 22 math validation sets. The experiments support the claimed allocation advantage in those settings, but not a guarantee for a reward model whose ranking is nonmonotone or adversarial.

核心理论证据是在奖励排序与验证成功之间满足单调性时，相对知分布最优策略的常数因子期望成本保证。它比只看准确率曲线信息更多，因为它说明廉价分数需要具备哪种隐含性质才能节省验证预算，并在这种结构不存在时给出下界。

经验上，论文检验排序假设，并在数学和代码任务上把 ADAP 与固定策略和难度自适应策略比较。在 83 个代码和 22 个数学验证问题中，最高排名的样本通过正确验证的概率是均匀选样的数倍。实验支持这些设置下的分配优势，但不保证奖励模型排序非单调或对抗时仍有效。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior adaptive inference work frequently allocates only samples or stopping time. This paper makes the full generate-rank-verify pipeline the decision object and prices the expensive terminal verifier separately from cheap ranking. Its contribution is therefore a budget policy over two resources, together with a distribution-aware benchmark, an online approximation, and a statement of the ranking assumption that makes the comparison meaningful.

The work does not claim to improve the generator or reward model itself. Its novelty is the auditability of allocation: the paper can say when a candidate was generated, what score put it in the verification set, what verification cost was paid, and why a policy must fail without usable score-label structure. This is especially relevant where hidden tests make each verification call scarce.

既有自适应推理工作常只分配样本数或停止时间。本文把完整的“生成—排序—验证”流水线作为决策对象，并将昂贵终止验证器与廉价排序分别计价。因此贡献是一项双资源预算策略，配以知分布基准、在线近似，以及让比较成立的排序假设说明。

该工作并未声称改进生成器或奖励模型本身。新意在于分配过程可审计：论文能说明候选何时生成、什么分数使它进入验证集合、支付了何种验证成本，以及没有可用分数—标签结构时策略为何必然失败。这对每次隐藏测试调用都很稀缺的场景尤其相关。

title: Limitations
局限
html: ADAP's guarantee depends on a monotone relationship between reward score and verification success; a reward model can violate that condition through calibration drift, reward hacking, or task shift. The method also assumes the generation and verification costs used by the policy represent the deployed system, while API latency, retries, parallelism, and hidden-test queueing can change the true trade-off. No public code or data link appears in the checked paper, so reproduction requires reconstructing implementation choices from the paper and independently validating the ranking premise.
ADAP 的保证依赖奖励分数与验证成功之间的单调关系；奖励模型可能因校准漂移、奖励投机或任务迁移而违反该条件。方法还假设策略使用的生成与验证成本代表真实部署，但 API 延迟、重试、并行和隐藏测试排队都会改变实际权衡。核验论文中没有公开代码或数据链接，因此复现需从论文重建实现选择，并独立验证排序前提。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when a system has a fast but noisy ranker and a slow high-confidence checker, especially for code execution, formal checking, or exact-answer evaluation. The practical checklist is to log candidate scores and verifier outcomes, estimate the score-success curve on held-out prompts, meter every verifier call, and compare against fixed budgets at equal terminal correctness. It provides a principled reason not to report pass rates without the cost of obtaining a verified answer.
当系统同时拥有快速但有噪声的排序器与缓慢、高置信度的检查器时，尤其适用于代码执行、形式检查或精确答案评测。实用清单是记录候选分数和验证结果，在留出提示上估计分数—成功曲线，计量每次验证调用，并在相同终端正确性下与固定预算比较。它为“不报告获得已验证答案所付成本的通过率”提供了原则性反驳。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The key unit is not a sampled answer alone but a scored candidate paired with a costly binary verification result. The oracle policy is a success-probability threshold; ADAP is the unknown-distribution shellwise approximation. Its main assumption is rank monotonicity, not perfect calibration. Read the result as a compute-allocation theorem and an experimental diagnostic for verifier use, rather than as evidence that any reward model can safely decide which answers deserve checking.
关键单位不是孤立的采样答案，而是带分数的候选与昂贵二元验证结果的配对。最优策略是成功概率阈值；ADAP 是未知分布下的分层近似。其主要假设是排名单调性，而非完美校准。应把结果读作计算分配定理和验证器使用的实验诊断，而不是任何奖励模型都能安全决定哪些答案值得检查的证据。
